title: Exact discrete OT / Wasserstein-1 over Q (integer min-cost-flow, totally-unimodular => exact)
method: rational masses scaled to common integer denominator D=lcm(dens); integer min-cost max-flow (SPFA successive shortest paths); W1 = optimal_cost / D. No Sinkhorn, no float.
